decision_rule: MARKET_BASELINE_EVALUABLE requires no integrity failure, at least 50 paired verified unique matches, and a deterministic settlement-correct baseline; this does not authorize a model change

funnel.observation_unit: one football match = one unique match_key

horizon_map.timestamp_rule: kickoff_at - freeze_created_at; both timezone-aware; freeze strictly before kickoff

selection.selection_rule: existing is_formally_eligible gate, then select_latest_legal_prematch by source_cutoff_at, freeze_created_at, prediction_created_at, prediction_id; identity/chronology guarded

ou_solve_diagnostics.settlement: exact Asian full_win/half_win/push/half_loss semantics via market_contracts.split_quarter_line

actual_score_rank.champion_surface: persisted score_top5 only; rank is null when actual score is outside that surface
actual_score_rank.market_surface: full normalized rho=0 score matrix support

bootstrap.unit: one football match = one unique match_key

policy.hk_water: positive HK net water only; decimal = 1 + water; invalid/non-finite/non-positive fail closed
policy.home_away_split: rho=0; bounded deterministic golden-section loss against frozen 1X2 consensus; no AH input
policy.market_cutoff: source snapshot fetched_at must be <= selected source_cutoff_at and strictly before kickoff
policy.one_x2: current spf_current decimal odds, proportional inverse-odds de-vig per bookmaker, equal-weight fair vectors
policy.ou: current line + both current waters; exact quarter-line Asian settlement; solve lambda_total per bookmaker; aggregate by fixed median
policy.version_selection: existing is_formally_eligible gate, then select_latest_legal_prematch by source_cutoff_at, freeze_created_at, prediction_created_at, prediction_id; identity/chronology guarded

devig.bookmaker_aggregation_1x2: equal-weight valid bookmaker fair vectors, normalize consensus once

replay_parity.reason: formal full-support persistence and immutable replay parity are both required; Top1/3/5 alone are not a full distribution
